newsitem.title: USA: Vista 2000 Inc 1996 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Vista 2000 Inc 1996 net loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The company said its 1996 year ended December 28.
The company was not available to comment on its average shares outstanding for fiscal 1995.
Net loss for fiscal 1996 includes a write-down of $10,787,000, or $0.67 per share, for operating assets.
The average shares outstanding for fiscal 1996 does not include approximately 14,226,000 shares to be issued under the terms of the class action settlement reached in March 1997.
Sales for 1996 include 12 months sales for its American Consumer Products Inc (ACPI) subsidiary, which was acquired in September 1995, while 1995 sales include only three months of ACPI's sales.
In 1996 ACPI accounted for $100,389,000 or approximately 90 percent of the company's total sales for the 1996 year.
